description: Single-game deep dive: phase tapestry, event chronicle, and trace forensics

panels.description: Normal: 1 (green) means game completed. Watch for: 0 (yellow) on a game that should have finished. Check next: Event Chronicle for last event.
panels.title: Game Completed

panels.description: Normal: 20-150 total moves (green). Watch for: > 150 (yellow) above fleet p84; > 400 (red) above fleet p97.5. Check next: Fleet Move Distribution for percentiles.
panels.title: Move Count

panels.description: Normal: attack moves proportional to total moves. Watch for: > 75 (yellow) above fleet p84. Check next: Fleet Attack Distribution for percentiles.
panels.title: Attack Count

panels.description: Normal: a few eliminations and continent events per game. Watch for: > 8 (yellow) above fleet p84; > 20 (red) above fleet p97.5. Check next: Fleet Headline Distribution.
panels.title: Headline Count

panels.description: Normal: < 200ms fleet average (green). Watch for: > 200ms (yellow) degraded performance; > 500ms (red) severe. Check next: Move Forensics trace for slow move detail.
panels.title: Avg Move Latency

panels.description: Normal: phase transitions proportional to player count and game length. Watch for: > 40 (yellow) above fleet p84; > 100 (red) above fleet p97.5. Check next: Fleet Turn Distribution.
panels.title: Turn Count

panels.description: Normal: p50 moves 30-80, p95 under 200. Watch for: percentile curves trending upward (games getting longer). Check next: compare with this game's Move Count stat tile above.
panels.title: Fleet Move Distribution

panels.description: Normal: p50 attacks 15-40, p95 under 100. Watch for: attack percentiles growing faster than move percentiles (more combat-heavy meta). Check next: compare with Attack Count tile.
panels.title: Fleet Attack Distribution

panels.description: Normal: p50 turns 10-30, p95 under 80. Watch for: rising turn counts suggest games taking more rounds. Check next: compare with Turn Count tile above.
panels.title: Fleet Turn Distribution

panels.description: Normal: p50 headlines 2-5, p95 under 15. Watch for: unusually flat distribution (all games similar) or extreme outliers. Check next: compare with Headline Count tile.
panels.title: Fleet Headline Distribution

panels.description: Normal: colored markers per player at each phase transition (DEPLOY=blue, ATTACK=red, CARDS=gold, CONQUER=green, REINFORCE=purple). Gaps = idle (not their turn). Dense markers = active turn. Watch for: long gaps (eliminated player) or stuck phases. Check next: Event Chronicle for detailed event sequence.

targets.expr: {service_name="risk-it"} |= "game_event" | gameId=`$gameId` | eventType=~`move_executed|phase_transitioned|turn_ended` | keep payload_user_id, payload_action_type, payload_turn | line_format "{{ if eq .payload_action_type \"WAITING\" }}WAITING{{ else }}{{.payload_action_type}}_{{.payload_turn}}{{ end }}" | drop payload_action_type, payload_turn

panels.title: Phase Tapestry

panels.description: Normal: dense band in low-millisecond range (fast moves). Watch for: heat spreading to higher buckets over time. Check next: Move Forensics for individual slow traces.
panels.title: Move Latency Distribution

panels.description: Normal: player eliminations and continent captures during gameplay. Watch for: rapid consecutive eliminations (one player dominating) or no headlines (passive game). Check next: Event Chronicle for full event log.
panels.title: Headline Moments

panels.description: Normal: chronological event log for this game. Watch for: gaps in event sequence or repeated errors. Check next: click a trace ID to load Move Forensics below.
panels.title: Event Chronicle

panels.description: Normal: complete span tree for the selected trace. Watch for: missing spans (instrumentation gaps) or long gaps between spans (contention). Check next: Correlated Logs below.
panels.title: Move Forensics

panels.description: Normal: log lines matching the traced request. Watch for: error-level entries or unexpected patterns. Check next: return to Phase Tapestry for game-level context.
panels.title: Correlated Logs

title: Game Theater
